prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 Y2K direct-flash portrait of an adult woman inside an unbranded car at night. She has long voluminous blonde layered hair with darker roots, winged eyeliner, mascara, and glossy pink-nude lips. She wears a two-tone teal-and-maroon long-sleeve raglan shirt with a blank chest, high-waisted light-wash jeans, layered silver chains with an abstract pendant, and silver rings. Pose her sitting upright with one cheek gently resting on her hand and the other arm across her lap. Include a dark headrest and abstract street-light window reflections, direct flash, deep shadows, natural skin, realistic denim, light film grain, and no logos or readable text.
